tag: tess-hunt FFI search, sector 1 detection, multi-sector confirmed
notes: Detected in an independent BLS search of SPOC FFI cutouts (astrocut, S3 cubes) of Tmag 12-15 M dwarfs. Signal recovered independently in every available sector. Centroid and noise-normalized difference images place the dip on the target in all tested 200-s sectors. Odd/even depths agree within 2.1 sigma; no secondary eclipse. batman+emcee fit with free quadratic limb darkening. Transit-derived stellar density 4.2 solar vs TIC 5.0 solar. Not a TOI; no literature match; CTOI list check pending ExoFOP availability.
